newsitem.title: UK: Kalon acquires interest in S. African firm.
newsitem.headline: Kalon acquires interest in S. African firm.

text.p: Anglo-French paints and building chemicals maker Kalon Group Plc said on Friday it had agreed to acquire 70 percent of the business of Prominent Paints (Pty) Ltd in South Africa.
Prominent, based in Alberton, on the outskirts of Johannesburg, specialises in decorative paints.
Kalon said it was paying cash but did not reveal the price of the transaction.
Prominent's sales for the year ended February, 1997 stood at 12.7 million stg with net assets at 1.67 million stg.
"The acquisition opens up a new market opportunity for Kalon in South Africa which has a growing decorative paint market valued at approximately 140 million stg in 1996," the UK company said.
